# stb_vorbis

`stb_vorbis.c` v1.22 from https://github.com/nothings/stb (commit
`2c980bb59875b0d32144a71867fbdebb2f77cd20`), unmodified. Public domain or
MIT, at your choice (license text at the end of the file).

Used by `runner/dkc1_msu1.c` (built through `runner/dkc1_stb_vorbis.c`) to
stream compressed MSU-1 tracks produced by `tools/msu1_compress.py`.
